chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs ibn Uthman, from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire,' [he was asked] 'How can we save our families?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'You should enjoin them [to do good] and forbid them [from evil].'
ai.seo_question: How do we practically save our families from Hellfire according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the mechanism of 'Qud anfusakum wa ahlikum' by defining it as active moral supervision (amr bi-l-ma'ruf wa nahy 'an al-munkar) within the household. It underscores the patriarchal or head-of-household's responsibility to enforce religious discipline, transforming the Quranic verse from a passive warning into a directive for continuous familial guidance and accountability.
